title: huernia occellata
intro: Huernia occellata, commonly known as the eye-spotted Huernia or spotted Huernia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its potential medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Huernia occellata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides. Research has identified several bioactive compounds, including huernin, huernine, and 7-oxo-3,4-dihydro-5H-furo[3,2-g]chromen-8-carboxylic acid, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
